title: Verdium+
description: Modpack that will improve your vanilla game experience
body:
# VERDIUM+
**102** Mods to Enhance Your Gameplay


This modpack is designed for players who love the classic feel of vanilla Minecraft but want to enhance it with quality-of-life improvements.

**The modpack was created for a private vanilla minecraft server** [VERDIUM](https://discord.gg/fErtsgVmmd)


Modpack contains:
- 🔧 Improved core gameplay
- 🎨 Visual and UI enhancements
- 🚀 Optimized for performance

🔋 Requires a minimum of **8 GB RAM** for optimal performance.

## vanilla, but better
